summary: Regression testing completed: backend 4/4 passed; dashboard, routes, stat IDs, notifications, and mobile menu/overflow passed. Order POST persists via API, but the browser orders table displayed stale zero-state data after creation. Quick-add remains non-functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Hızlı kayıt has no handler and does not navigate or open a form.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/orders returns 200 and the record persists, but the browser orders table continues to render 0 kayıt/empty state after submission and reload.

action_items: Implement quick-add navigation or modal flow.
Fix dashboard data fetching/table refresh so newly persisted orders appear in Siparişler without stale data.
critical_code_review_comments: App loads dashboard data only once and TablePage relies on that snapshot; after mutations it uses window.location.reload(), which can still render stale cached dashboard data. Add explicit refetch/no-cache or local state update and show API errors in the UI.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed material, product, sale, and orders through regression/API and UI tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation, stat uniqueness, notifications, mobile menu, and no horizontal overflow passed. Re-test order table refresh and quick-add after fixes.
rca of the issue: The order branch now correctly POSTs to /api/orders and backend persistence is confirmed. The UI still renders the dashboard snapshot held in App state; the observed empty table indicates the post-submit reload/data request is serving or retaining stale dashboard data. Quick-add has no onClick handler in Dashboard.
